segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for hopping on. Sorry I'm a couple minutes late, I was cleaning up duplicate contacts in the CRM and it ran over. For today I wanted to confirm the 48 seats, the April 15 go-live, and the support tier.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No worries. The 48 seats is right for phase one. We may add 12 more in June if the service team likes it, but I don't want those on the initial invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, initial order for 48 only. At $72 per user per month on the annual term, that puts subscription at $41,472, plus the one-time implementation fee of $6,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I have. Can you make the payment terms net 45? Our AP group pushes back on net 30 unless it is under ten grand.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can ask for net 45. The pricing sheet supports it at this amount, but deal desk will want the internal approval packet completed before I send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Also, legal asked if the auto-renewal can be 12 months with 60 days notice instead of 90. That's been a sticking point for us.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that should be workable. I will redline that to 60 days and keep the initial term through April 14 of next year. No change to the go-live plan.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. We need the sandbox by April 1, then production on April 15. Training for managers would be 16 people, probably two sessions.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. I have a 3:30 with our onboarding lead, so after I type these changes into the pipeline and billing tool I'll block two 90-minute trainings for the week of April 8.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send me the updated order form when you have it, and I can get signature routed tomorrow if the invoice totals are clean.
